shots.speaker: VOLKOV
shots.text: My van's still staged at the dock, I haven't bailed on you yet. Through that smoke, friend, and don't make me regret it.

shots.speaker: BALACEANU (PA)
shots.text: Sweep teams: the prisoner is in the lobby levels. Free fire, my address begins at 22:00, and I will not be interrupted.

shots.speaker: VASILE
shots.text: The loading dock is your only way out, Volkov's van is staged there. Hold it, and the Vostral goes live tonight.
